title: Filing: Alphabet agrees to additional privacy protections to salvage its $10M acquisition of bankrupt Spirit Airlines' data, resolving union objections (Alexander Gladstone/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Alexander Gladstone / Wall Street Journal: Filing: Alphabet agrees to additional privacy protections to salvage its $10M acquisition of bankrupt Spirit Airlines' data, resolving union objections — Google parent Alphabet agreed to provide additional privacy protections to salvage its $10 million acquisition of data from bankrupt Spirit Airlines.
